verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the regulated entity to maintain or have an organizational/technical capability concerning the detection or recording of data-security or ICT-related incidents.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires keeping a register or overview of all personal-data breaches, including specified facts and information. Norm B requires financial entities to possess mechanisms that detect anomalous activities, ICT network-performance issues, ICT-related incidents, and potential physical single points of failure as soon as possible, with regular testing. verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions are materially different in object and mechanism: A controls which suppliers' products or services may be used, while B requires implementation and use of ICT security technologies and processes with specified protective capabilities.
verdict.evidence_span_a: uitsluitend gebruik te maken van producten of diensten van anderen dan de daarbij door Onze Minister die het aangaat genoemde partij
verdict.evidence_span_b: voorkomen een gebrek aan beschikbaarheid, de aantasting van de authenticiteit en integriteit, de inbreuken op de vertrouwelijkheid en het verlies van gegevens

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen houden verband met communicatie rond digitale/ICT-risico’s of incidenten, maar vereisen niet dezelfde concrete handeling.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A verplicht bepaalde organisaties om de minister op verzoek én uit eigen beweging noodzakelijke gegevens en inlichtingen te verstrekken, zodat maatregelen tegen inbreuken op veilige elektronische toegang kunnen worden genomen. Norm B verplicht een financiële entiteit om een persoon aan te wijzen die de communicatiestrategie voor ICT-incidenten uitvoert en als woordvoerder optreedt tegenover publiek en media.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste compliance-acties verschillen wezenlijk: informatieverstrekking aan een overheidsminister versus interne toewijzing van verantwoordelijkheid en externe woordvoering bij ICT-incidenten.
verdict.evidence_span_a: verstrekken aan Onze Minister desgevraagd en uit eigen beweging de gegevens en inlichtingen die hij nodig heeft
verdict.evidence_span_b: wordt belast met de uitvoering van de communicatiestrategie voor ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en vervult daartoe de rol van woordvoerder bij het publiek en de media

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require an entity to provide information to a public authority, but the information-sharing duties are substantively different.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires a central contact point to submit a recurring, every-three-months aggregated and anonymized report covering categories of cyber incidents and threats to ENISA. Norm B requires financial entities, only upon request, to communicate changes implemented after post-incident ICT evaluations to competent authorities; it is an ad hoc disclosure of remediation changes, not a periodic incident report.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required information, reporting frequency, triggering procedure, and practical compliance activity differ materially: periodic aggregated reporting to ENISA versus request-based disclosure of post-incident changes to competent authorities.
verdict.evidence_span_a: dient om de drie maanden bij Enisa een samenvattend verslag in met geanonimiseerde en geaggregeerde gegevens over significante incidenten, incidenten, cyberdreigingen en bijna-incidenten
verdict.evidence_span_b: delen op verzoek de bevoegde autoriteiten de wijzigingen mee die na de in de eerste alinea bedoelde ICT-gerelateerde post-incidentevaluaties zijn doorgevoerd

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen betreffen ICT-gerelateerde verplichtingen voor bepaalde entiteiten, maar zij leggen niet dezelfde concrete compliance-actie op.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A verplicht essentiële of belangrijke entiteiten om elk significant incident overeenkomstig de voorgeschreven artikelen te melden. Norm B verplicht bepaalde kleine of vrijgestelde financiële entiteiten tot een breed ICT-risicobeheerkader, waaronder — waar toepasselijk — het opnemen van operationele conclusies uit tests en incidentanalyses in het ICT-risicobeoordelingsproces. Dat is interne risicobeheerdocumentatie en geen incidentmelding aan een externe autoriteit.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste handeling verschilt materieel: externe melding van ieder significant incident versus interne inrichting en voortdurende uitvoering van ICT-risicobeheer, inclusief verwerking van lessen uit tests en incidenten.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De essentiële entiteit of belangrijke entiteit meldt overeenkomstig de artikelen 26 tot en met 29 ieder significant incident.
verdict.evidence_span_b: in voorkomend geval de relevante operationele conclusies die voortvloeien uit de in punt g) bedoelde tests en uit de analyse na een incident opnemen in het ICT-risicobeoordelingsproces

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms respond to ICT-related events by requiring the regulated entity to take a prompt compliance measure, but the measures are materially different.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires reporting a significant incident to the CSIRT and competent authority, including specified incident information; Norm B requires financial entities to maintain and regularly test mechanisms for detecting anomalous activities, ICT incidents, and physical single points of failure. One is an incident-notification duty, the other is an ongoing detection-capability duty.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions have different objects, recipients, and operational substance: external notification versus internal detection mechanisms and testing.
verdict.evidence_span_a: een melding van het significante incident in bij haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: beschikken over mechanismen om overeenkomstig artikel 17 afwijkende activiteiten zo spoedig mogelijk te detecteren

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms address organizational handling of ICT/significant incidents, including an element of incident reporting or communication.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires an essential or important entity to send a specific early warning about a known significant incident to its CSIRT and competent authority, immediately or within 24 hours, with specified information. Norm B requires a financial entity to establish and implement an ongoing internal ICT-incident management process covering detection, classification, responsibilities, communications, escalation, and response; it does not itself require the specific 24-hour early-warning notification to those authorities.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action differs in substance: an incident-triggered, time-bound external notification versus creation and operation of a comprehensive incident-management process.
verdict.evidence_span_a: geeft ten behoeve van de melding, bedoeld in artikel 27, eerste lid, een vroegtijdige waarschuwing over het significante incident aan haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: omschrijven een beheerproces voor ICT-gerelateerde incidenten, stellen dit vast en leggen dit ten uitvoer

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen zien op een handeling die naar aanleiding van een ernstig ICT-/AI-incident moet worden verricht, maar de concrete handeling verschilt: norm A vereist periodieke en incidentgerelateerde documentatie en evaluatie van een ICT-risicobeheerkader, terwijl norm B een ernstig incident bij markttoezichtautoriteiten moet laten melden.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A betreft interne documentatie en evaluatie van een risicobeheerkader; norm B betreft externe incidentmelding aan markttoezichtautoriteiten, met een uiterste termijn van twee dagen na bewustwording bij de specifieke incidentcategorie.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste compliance-acties zijn substantieel verschillend: evalueren/documenteren van een intern kader versus melden van een incident aan een bevoegde externe autoriteit.
verdict.evidence_span_a: wordt overeenkomstig de toezichtinstructies op gezette tijden en bij ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incidenten gedocumenteerd en geëvalueerd
verdict.evidence_span_b: de in lid 1 van dit artikel bedoelde melding onmiddellijk gedaan, doch uiterlijk twee dagen nadat de aanbieder of, in voorkomend geval, de gebruiksverantwoordelijke zich bewust wordt van dat incident

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern communicating information about a security or personal-data breach to an external recipient, including information intended to describe or address the incident.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes an urgent duty to notify the Minister of a breach affecting the notifying body's own electronic service or misuse of access, and to provide all necessary information. Norm B specifies the mandatory substantive contents of notifications to the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the affected person, including the breach's nature, information sources, mitigation measures, and— for the Authority—its consequences and response measures. They therefore involve different recipients and materially different notification duties, not merely different wording.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action differs in substance: urgent incident reporting to the Minister versus providing prescribed breach-notification content to the data-protection authority and affected individual.
verdict.evidence_span_a: stelt Onze Minister onverwijld in kennis van een inbreuk op de beveiliging of de integriteit van een eigen elektronische dienst of van misbruik of oneigenlijk gebruik van de toegang tot de eigen elektronische dienstverlening
verdict.evidence_span_b: De kennisgeving aan de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens en de persoon wiens persoonsgegevens het betreft, omvat in ieder geval de aard van de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de instanties waar meer informatie over de inbreuk kan worden verkregen en de aanbevolen maatregelen om de negatieve gevolgen van de inbreuk te beperken.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational responses to cybersecurity-related events and risks by entities operating in the digital/communications sphere.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires immediate external notification to the Dutch Data Protection Authority of a qualifying security breach affecting personal-data protection. Norm B requires financial entities to maintain capabilities and staff resources to gather information about vulnerabilities, cyber threats, and ICT incidents and analyze their likely effects; it does not require reporting an incident to a regulator.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions are substantively different: mandatory regulatory breach notification versus maintaining internal information-gathering and analytical capacity.
verdict.evidence_span_a: stelt de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens onverwijld in kennis van een inbreuk op de beveiliging
verdict.evidence_span_b: beschikken over capaciteiten en personele middelen om informatie te verzamelen over kwetsbaarheden en cyberdreigingen, ICT-gerelateerde incidenten, met name cyberaanvallen, en om de waarschijnlijke gevolgen ervan voor hun digitale operationele weerbaarheid te analyseren

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered in the context of an incident and require the regulated entity to take active follow-up measures concerning that incident.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires financial entities, during ICT-incident recovery, to perform controls and reconciliations aimed at maintaining data integrity, including when reconstructing external-party data. Norm B requires an AI-system provider, after reporting a serious incident, to promptly investigate the incident and system, including risk assessment and corrective measures, while cooperating with authorities and avoiding potentially prejudicial system changes without prior notice. These are different substantive actions: data-integrity validation versus incident investigation and remediation.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required operational action differs in substance: verification/reconciliation of recovered data under Norm A versus investigation, risk assessment, and corrective action under Norm B.
verdict.evidence_span_a: verrichten financiële entiteiten de benodigde controles, ook meerdere controles, waaronder afstemmingen, om ervoor te zorgen dat het hoogste niveau van gegevensintegriteit wordt gehandhaafd
verdict.evidence_span_b: verricht de aanbieder onverwijld het nodige onderzoek in verband met het ernstige incident en het betrokken AI-systeem

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen betreffen het vastleggen/documenteren van informatie over incidenten en daarmee een vorm van incidentregistratie.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A vereist een doorlopende, algemene registratie van alle ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en significante cyberdreigingen, plus procedures voor monitoring, behandeling, follow-up en het wegnemen van onderliggende oorzaken. Norm B vereist specifiek het bijhouden en documenteren van informatie over ernstige incidenten en mogelijke corrigerende maatregelen én onverwijlde rapportage daarvan aan het AI-bureau en eventueel nationale autoriteiten. De externe rapportageplicht en de beperkte, specifieke incidentcategorie maken de praktische compliance-actie wezenlijk anders.
verdict.criterion_fired: De normen delen incidentregistratie/documentatie als element, maar Norm B voegt een onmiddellijke meldplicht aan toezichthouders toe en ziet op andere, specifiek afgebakende informatie; Norm A ziet primair op interne registratie en incidentbeheer.
verdict.evidence_span_a: Financiële entiteiten registreren alle ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en significante cyberdreigingen.
verdict.evidence_span_b: relevante informatie over ernstige incidenten en mogelijke corrigerende maatregelen bijhouden, documenteren en onverwijld rapporteren aan het AI-bureau en, in voorkomend geval, aan de nationale bevoegde autoriteiten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern obligations imposed on entities in response to ICT or national-security-related risks, but their required actions are not the same: Norm A requires restricting procurement/use of products or services by excluding a minister-designated risky party; Norm B requires conducting post-incident evaluations and, for non-micro financial entities, reporting resulting changes to competent authorities upon request.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is a preventive supplier/product-use restriction, potentially including replacement or termination of existing services within a minister-set period. Norm B is a post-incident assessment, improvement-identification, and request-based notification duty concerning implemented changes.
verdict.criterion_fired: The operative compliance actions differ in substance: exclusion of designated suppliers versus evaluation of incidents and communication of resulting changes.
verdict.evidence_span_a: uitsluitend gebruik te maken van producten of diensten van anderen dan de daarbij door Onze Minister die het aangaat genoemde partij
verdict.evidence_span_b: delen op verzoek de bevoegde autoriteiten de wijzigingen mee die na de in de eerste alinea bedoelde ICT-gerelateerde post-incidentevaluaties zijn doorgevoerd

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the addressee to report incident-related information promptly to designated public authorities. However, Norm A requires a significant-incident notification by a trust-service provider to its CSIRT and competent authority, with the special 24-hour deadline and the fuller notification contents supplied by Article 27(1). Norm B requires providers of system-risk general-purpose AI models to keep and document information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures and report it without delay to the AI Office and, where appropriate, national competent authorities.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: The reporting duties differ materially in subject matter and scope: Norm A is an incident notification concerning a significant incident affecting provision of a trust service, including specified incident-assessment, impact, compromise-indicator, and cross-border-effect information. Norm B combines record-keeping and documentation with reporting information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures, directed primarily to the AI Office and only conditionally to national authorities. The different regulated activities, incident categories, recipients, and required information make the practical compliance obligations distinct.
verdict.criterion_fired: Although both impose prompt incident-related reporting to public bodies, they do not require substantially the same compliance action because their substantive reporting content, trigger scope, recipient structure, and ancillary record-keeping duties differ.
verdict.evidence_span_a: een melding van het significante incident in bij haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: relevante informatie over ernstige incidenten en mogelijke corrigerende maatregelen bijhouden, documenteren en onverwijld rapporteren aan het AI-bureau en, in voorkomend geval, aan de nationale bevoegde autoriteiten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the responsible provider to make a prompt notification/report after becoming aware of a qualifying harmful event or incident.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires notifying the affected individual whose personal data are involved about a personal-data breach likely to adversely affect that person's privacy. Norm B requires providers of high-risk AI systems to report serious incidents to Member State market-surveillance authorities, with incident-specific deadlines (generally immediately and no later than 15 days, subject to shorter periods in specified cases). The recipient and substantive purpose therefore differ: individual privacy notification versus regulatory incident reporting.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is substantively different because the mandatory recipient and function differ: affected-person notification under A versus authority reporting under B.
verdict.evidence_span_a: stelt degene wiens persoonsgegevens het betreft onverwijld in kennis van een inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens
verdict.evidence_span_b: De in lid 1 bedoelde melding wordt gedaan onmiddellijk nadat de aanbieder een oorzakelijk verband tussen het AI-systeem en het ernstige incident of de redelijke waarschijnlijkheid van een dergelijk verband heeft vastgesteld en in ieder geval uiterlijk 15 dagen nadat de aanbieder of, in voorkomend geval, de gebruiksverantwoordelijke zich bewust wordt van het ernstige incident.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen houden verband met verplichtingen die ontstaan in de context van digitale risico’s of systemen, maar zij vereisen niet dezelfde concrete handeling.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A verplicht de entiteit tot het invoeren en onderhouden van een brede, risicogebaseerde set cyberbeveiligingsmaatregelen. Norm B verplicht de gebruiksverantwoordelijke daarentegen om de resultaten van een reeds uitgevoerde grondrechteneffectbeoordeling aan de markttoezichtautoriteit te melden en een ingevuld sjabloon mee te sturen.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste compliance-acties verschillen wezenlijk: interne technische en organisatorische beveiligingsmaatregelen tegenover externe kennisgeving en indiening van documentatie.
verdict.evidence_span_a: zijn gebaseerd op een benadering die alle gevaren omvat en tot doel heeft netwerk- en informatiesystemen en de fysieke omgeving van die systemen tegen incidenten te beschermen, en omvatten ten minste het volgende
verdict.evidence_span_b: stelt de gebruiksverantwoordelijke de markttoezichtautoriteit in kennis van de resultaten ervan, en dient hij als onderdeel van de kennisgeving het in lid 5 van dit artikel bedoelde ingevulde sjabloon in

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require an incident-related notification concerning a significant/personal-data breach, made promptly after the triggering event.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the entity to report the significant incident to institutional cybersecurity recipients (its CSIRT and competent authority), within 24 hours if immediate reporting is impossible, with the fuller report content supplied by paragraph 1. Norm B requires notifying the affected individual whose personal data are involved, without delay, where the breach is likely to adversely affect that person's privacy; the duty may be unnecessary where adequate protective measures make the data unintelligible, and the supervisory authority may require notification if omitted.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required recipient and substantive compliance objective differ: regulatory/cybersecurity reporting to CSIRT and competent authority versus individual data-subject notification for privacy protection.
verdict.evidence_span_a: een melding van het significante incident in bij haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: stelt degene wiens persoonsgegevens het betreft onverwijld in kennis van een inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require an entity to provide information to a public authority, but the information and triggering conditions differ.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires a trust-service provider to proactively report a significant incident affecting its trust services to the CSIRT or competent authority within 24 hours of becoming aware of it. Norm B requires non-micro financial entities to provide, only upon request, an estimate of aggregate annual costs and losses from serious ICT-related incidents. The duties therefore differ in subject matter, trigger, and timing.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is substantively different: proactive incident notification within a fixed deadline versus reactive provision of an annual cost-and-loss estimate upon request.
verdict.evidence_span_a: meldt een verlener van vertrouwensdiensten significante incidenten die gevolgen hebben voor de verlening van zijn vertrouwensdiensten onverwijld, en in elk geval binnen 24 uur nadat hij kennis heeft gekregen van het significante incident, bij het CSIRT of, indien van toepassing, de bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: verstrekken de bevoegde autoriteiten op hun verzoek een raming van de geaggregeerde jaarlijkse kosten en verliezen als gevolg van ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incidenten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms respond to a data/ICT security event by requiring the regulated entity to take a compliance-related action concerning information about that event and its consequences or mitigation.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the controller to internally document every personal-data breach, including facts, consequences, and corrective measures, so the supervisory authority can verify compliance. Norm B requires financial entities to notify their clients without delay about a serious ICT incident and mitigation measures (and, where appropriate, protective measures concerning a significant cyberthreat). The addressee and action—internal regulatory documentation versus external client notification—are substantively different.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is different in substance: record-keeping/documentation for supervisory control versus urgent communication to affected or potentially affected clients.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De verwerkingsverantwoordelijke documenteert alle inbreuken in verband met persoonsgegevens, met inbegrip van de feiten omtrent de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de gevolgen daarvan en de genomen corrigerende maatregelen.
verdict.evidence_span_b: stellen financiële entiteiten, zodra zij het incident hebben opgemerkt, hun cliënten onverwijld in kennis van het ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incident en van de maatregelen die zijn genomen om de negatieve gevolgen van een dergelijk incident te beperken.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen houden verband met risico’s of schade in de context van digitale gegevensverwerking, maar leggen geen substantieel dezelfde compliance-actie op.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A legt een aansprakelijkheids- en schadevergoedingsgevolg op bij onrechtmatige verwerking; norm B verplicht financiële entiteiten tot een doorlopende en periodieke identificatie en beoordeling van ICT-risico’s, cyberdreigingen en kwetsbaarheden.
verdict.criterion_fired: De feitelijke verplichtingen verschillen wezenlijk: aansprakelijkheid achteraf voor veroorzaakte schade versus een preventieve, voortdurende risicobeoordelingsplicht.
verdict.evidence_span_a: Elke verwerkingsverantwoordelijke die bij verwerking is betrokken, is aansprakelijk voor de schade die wordt veroorzaakt door verwerking die inbreuk maakt op deze verordening.
verdict.evidence_span_b: Financiële entiteiten identificeren permanent alle bronnen van ICT-risico, met name de wederzijdse risicoblootstelling ten aanzien van andere financiële entiteiten, en beoordelen de cyberdreigingen en ICT-kwetsbaarheden die relevant zijn voor hun door ICT ondersteunde bedrijfsfuncties en informatie- en ICT-activa.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern responding to ICT-related incidents, but they require different compliance actions: Norm A requires the entity to submit a substantive final (or, where applicable, interim-progress) incident report to its CSIRT and competent authority, including specified incident details and mitigation information. Norm B requires appointing at least one person to implement the ICT-incident communications strategy and act as spokesperson to the public and media.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is a time-bound regulatory reporting and information-submission duty to supervisory/incident-response authorities. Norm B is an internal role-assignment and external communications duty involving public and media spokesperson responsibilities.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required real-world actions, recipients, and functions differ substantially: formal incident reporting to authorities versus assigning a communications spokesperson for public and media communications.
verdict.evidence_span_a: een eindverslag in bij haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit waarin het volgende is opgenomen
verdict.evidence_span_b: Ten minste één persoon in de financiële entiteit wordt belast met de uitvoering van de communicatiestrategie voor ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en vervult daartoe de rol van woordvoerder bij het publiek en de media.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered by a serious/significant incident and require an incident-related response without delay, but they do not require the same practical compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires notifying the service recipients affected by a significant incident; Norm B requires reporting a serious incident to the national market-surveillance authority and also requires immediate risk mitigation, suspension or termination of testing, and a recall procedure. The addressee and substantive response therefore differ.
verdict.criterion_fired: Different mandatory action and recipient: customer/service-recipient notification versus regulatory reporting and operational risk-containment measures.
verdict.evidence_span_a: stelt in voorkomend geval onverwijld de ontvangers van haar diensten in kennis van significante incidenten die een nadelige invloed kunnen hebben op de verlening van die diensten
verdict.evidence_span_b: wordt gemeld bij de nationale markttoezichtautoriteit overeenkomstig artikel 73

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered in the context of regulated data processing/reporting activity and concern the relevant regulated entity, but they do not require the same practical compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes substantive liability for damage caused by processing that breaches the GDPR (with processor-specific limits). Norm B requires data-reporting service providers to maintain operational systems that check transaction reports for completeness, detect omissions and obvious errors, and request retransmission. One is a liability/consequence rule; the other is a preventive detection and retransmission capability.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required real-world actions differ in substance: assuming legal responsibility for qualifying damage versus implementing and operating systems for report validation, error detection, and retransmission requests.
verdict.evidence_span_a: is aansprakelijk voor de schade die wordt veroorzaakt door verwerking die inbreuk maakt op deze verordening
verdict.evidence_span_b: beschikken daarnaast over systemen die transactiemeldingen doeltreffend op volledigheid kunnen controleren, omissies en aperte fouten kunnen opsporen en om hernieuwde transmissie van die meldingen kunnen verzoeken

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both provisions concern legal consequences or measures connected to cybersecurity/data-law events, but they do not require the same practical compliance action. Norm A requires entities to implement and maintain a comprehensive set of cybersecurity risk-management measures, including incident handling, continuity, supply-chain security, secure development, training, and access controls. Norm B grants an injured person a right to obtain compensation from a controller or processor after a GDPR infringement; it primarily creates a liability/payment entitlement rather than a preventive security-management duty.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes an organizational and technical cybersecurity risk-management obligation on covered entities. Norm B establishes a private-law damages remedy for persons suffering material or immaterial damage from a GDPR infringement.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions are substantively different: preventive implementation of cybersecurity controls versus payment of damages to an injured person following a regulatory infringement.
verdict.evidence_span_a: zijn gebaseerd op een benadering die alle gevaren omvat en tot doel heeft netwerk- en informatiesystemen en de fysieke omgeving van die systemen tegen incidenten te beschermen, en omvatten ten minste het volgende
verdict.evidence_span_b: heeft het recht om van de verwerkingsverantwoordelijke of de verwerker schadevergoeding te ontvangen voor de geleden schade

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern handling information about a security or personal-data incident, but they require different compliance actions: Norm A requires an early warning to specified authorities/CSIRT within 24 hours, including specified preliminary information; Norm B requires internal documentation of all personal-data breaches, including facts, consequences, and corrective measures, so the supervisory authority can later verify compliance.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is an expedited external notification duty directed to the CSIRT and competent authority. Norm B is a record-keeping and documentation duty, with no immediate transmission to a recipient or deadline stated in the provision.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required real-world action differs in substance: prompt external reporting versus maintaining an internal compliance record.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De essentiële entiteit of belangrijke entiteit geeft ten behoeve van de melding, bedoeld in artikel 27, eerste lid, een vroegtijdige waarschuwing over het significante incident aan haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit.
verdict.evidence_span_b: De verwerkingsverantwoordelijke documenteert alle inbreuken in verband met persoonsgegevens, met inbegrip van de feiten omtrent de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de gevolgen daarvan en de genomen corrigerende maatregelen.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered by a serious ICT-related event and require a regulated entity to take a compliance-related response, but the required actions are not the same.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires conducting a post-incident evaluation, analyzing causes, assessing response procedures and effectiveness, and identifying improvements; Norm B requires reporting a qualifying serious incident to the designated national competent authority.

Norm B requires reporting a defined serious incident involving certain high-risk AI systems to the designated national competent authority where the incident occurred. The latter is a specific incident-notification duty, whereas the former is an ongoing information-supply duty supporting supervisory measures.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: general/proactive supervisory information provision versus mandatory reporting of a specified serious incident to a territorially designated authority.
verdict.evidence_span_a: verstrekken aan Onze Minister desgevraagd en uit eigen beweging de gegevens en inlichtingen die hij nodig heeft om maatregelen te kunnen nemen om inbreuk op de veilige en betrouwbare toegang tot elektronische dienstverlening te voorkomen of beëindigen
verdict.evidence_span_b: wordt het incident gemeld bij de nationale bevoegde autoriteit die daartoe is aangewezen door de lidstaten waar dat incident zich heeft voorgedaan

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require regulated entities to implement and maintain measures or processes addressing ICT/security risks and reducing their consequences.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires public electronic communications providers to take technical, operational, and organisational security-risk measures aimed at limiting the effects of security incidents on national security or public order. Norm B, as elaborated in its own provision, requires certain small or exempt financial entities to incorporate lessons from testing and post-incident analysis into their ICT-risk assessment process; it is one element of a broader, documented ICT-risk-management framework and is not equivalent to the general security-measures duty in Norm A.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ materially in object and operational content: Norm A is a general preventive security-control obligation, whereas Norm B specifically mandates feedback of test and incident-analysis conclusions into risk assessment, within a simplified financial-sector ICT-risk framework.
verdict.evidence_span_a: nemen bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur vastgestelde technische, operationele en organisatorische maatregelen om de risico’s voor de beveiliging van hun netwerken of diensten te beheersen, teneinde de gevolgen van beveiligingsincidenten op de nationale veiligheid of openbare orde te beperken
verdict.evidence_span_b: in voorkomend geval de relevante operationele conclusies die voortvloeien uit de in punt g) bedoelde tests en uit de analyse na een incident opnemen in het ICT-risicobeoordelingsproces

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered by an incident and concern organizational handling of that incident, but their required actions are not the same: Norm A requires the controller to communicate a personal-data breach to the affected data subject without undue delay (subject to the related exceptions and substitute public communication), whereas Norm B requires financial entities to classify ICT-related incidents and assess their effects using specified criteria.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes an external notification/information duty toward the data subject; Norm B imposes an internal incident-classification and impact-assessment duty, with no communication recipient or notification requirement.
verdict.criterion_fired: The operative compliance actions differ in substance: individual breach notification versus internal classification and impact determination.

verdict.evidence_span_b: Financiële entiteiten classificeren ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en bepalen de effecten daarvan op basis van de volgende criteria

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen verplichten een financiële entiteit/gebruiksverantwoordelijke om informatie aan een bevoegde overheidsinstantie te verstrekken nadat een voorafgaande beoordeling of gebeurtenis heeft plaatsgevonden.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A betreft doorlopende, ernstige ICT-incidentrapportage: een eerste kennisgeving, tussentijdse updates en een eindverslag, met informatie over de omvang en grensoverschrijdende gevolgen van het incident. Norm B betreft een eenmalige kennisgeving van de resultaten van een voorafgaande grondrechteneffectbeoordeling van een hoog-risico-AI-systeem, inclusief een ingevuld sjabloon.
verdict.criterion_fired: De concrete compliance-acties verschillen materieel: incidentrapportage met meerdere fasen en updates versus kennisgeving van de uitkomst van een voorafgaande grondrechtenbeoordeling met een ingevuld formulier.
verdict.evidence_span_a: Financiële entiteiten melden overeenkomstig lid 4 van dit artikel ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incidenten aan de relevante bevoegde autoriteit als bedoeld in artikel 46.
verdict.evidence_span_b: Zodra de in lid 1 van dit artikel bedoelde beoordeling is uitgevoerd, stelt de gebruiksverantwoordelijke de markttoezichtautoriteit in kennis van de resultaten ervan, en dient hij als onderdeel van de kennisgeving het in lid 5 van dit artikel bedoelde ingevulde sjabloon in.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern action following an ICT-related incident, but they require different practical measures: Norm A requires prompt notification of affected service recipients, whereas Norm B requires conducting post-incident evaluations and, upon request, reporting resulting changes to competent authorities.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: The addressee and action differ: Norm A communicates significant incident information to service recipients; Norm B communicates implemented post-evaluation changes to competent authorities and is part of a broader post-incident review obligation.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is substantively different in recipient, content, and function: external incident notification versus post-incident analysis and regulatory reporting.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational responses to digital/AI-related risks or incidents, but that is only a broad thematic overlap.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires financial entities to maintain capabilities and personnel for collecting and analyzing information about vulnerabilities, cyber threats, ICT incidents, and their likely effects. Norm B requires high-risk AI providers (and sometimes deployers) to report serious incidents to Member State market-surveillance authorities within specified deadlines, with shorter deadlines for certain cases.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions are substantively different: ongoing internal capability and resource provision versus external regulatory incident notification.
verdict.evidence_span_a: beschikken over capaciteiten en personele middelen om informatie te verzamelen over kwetsbaarheden en cyberdreigingen, ICT-gerelateerde incidenten, met name cyberaanvallen, en om de waarschijnlijke gevolgen ervan voor hun digitale operationele weerbaarheid te analyseren
verdict.evidence_span_b: De in lid 1 bedoelde melding wordt gedaan onmiddellijk nadat de aanbieder een oorzakelijk verband tussen het AI-systeem en het ernstige incident of de redelijke waarschijnlijkheid van een dergelijk verband heeft vastgesteld en in ieder geval uiterlijk 15 dagen nadat de aanbieder of, in voorkomend geval, de gebruiksverantwoordelijke zich bewust wordt van het ernstige incident.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern consequences following a legally relevant event involving a regulated entity, but they do not require the same practical compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes a proactive reporting duty: the entity must notify each significant incident in accordance with Articles 26–29. Norm B establishes civil liability for damage caused by unlawful processing (with processor-specific conditions); it does not require incident reporting or another comparable operational notification.
verdict.criterion_fired: The operative actions differ in substance: mandatory incident notification versus liability to compensate for damage caused by non-compliant processing.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De essentiële entiteit of belangrijke entiteit meldt overeenkomstig de artikelen 26 tot en met 29 ieder significant incident.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen zien op het reageren op een incident met een compliancehandeling, maar de feitelijke verplichtingen verschillen: norm A vereist interne documentatie van alle persoonsgegevensinbreuken, inclusief feiten, gevolgen en corrigerende maatregelen; norm B vereist een externe melding van ernstige AI-incidenten aan markttoezichtautoriteiten binnen specifieke termijnen.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A betreft registratie/documentatie voor controle door de toezichthoudende autoriteit en bevat geen meldingsplicht of termijn. Norm B betreft actieve externe rapportage aan markttoezichtautoriteiten, met onmiddellijke en uiterlijke termijnen van 15, 10 of 2 dagen afhankelijk van de omstandigheden.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste compliance-actie is substantieel verschillend: documenteren en beschikbaar houden voor toezicht versus melden aan een bevoegde autoriteit binnen een wettelijke termijn.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De verwerkingsverantwoordelijke documenteert alle inbreuken in verband met persoonsgegevens, met inbegrip van de feiten omtrent de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de gevolgen daarvan en de genomen corrigerende maatregelen.
verdict.evidence_span_b: De in lid 1 bedoelde melding wordt gedaan onmiddellijk nadat de aanbieder een oorzakelijk verband tussen het AI-systeem en het ernstige incident of de redelijke waarschijnlijkheid van een dergelijk verband heeft vastgesteld en in ieder geval uiterlijk 15 dagen nadat de aanbieder of, in voorkomend geval, de gebruiksverantwoordelijke zich bewust wordt van het ernstige incident.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the addressee to promptly notify another designated party after becoming aware of a security or personal-data breach.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires a public body or designated organization to notify the Minister about breaches affecting its own electronic service or misuse/unauthorized use of access, and to provide all necessary information. Norm B requires a processor to notify the controller, without unreasonable delay, upon becoming aware of a personal-data breach. The recipient, regulated relationship, triggering breach, and scope of the notification duty therefore differ materially.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required notification is directed to a different recipient and concerns a materially different substantive relationship and breach scope; the shared promptness and incident-notification structure do not make the compliance actions substantially identical.

verdict.evidence_span_b: informeert de verwerkingsverantwoordelijke zonder onredelijke vertraging zodra hij kennis heeft genomen van een inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both provisions concern regulatory consequences following a digital/data-related compliance event, but they do not require the same practical action: Norm A requires the controller to document personal-data breaches, while Norm B concerns the lead overseer imposing a coercive fine daily until obligations are fulfilled, for up to six months.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is a substantive record-keeping duty imposed on a data controller; Norm B is an enforcement power/action exercised by a lead overseer against a critical ICT third-party provider.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required actor, action, and practical compliance outcome differ materially: documentation of breaches versus imposition of a daily coercive fine.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De verwerkingsverantwoordelijke documenteert alle inbreuken in verband met persoonsgegevens, met inbegrip van de feiten omtrent de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de gevolgen daarvan en de genomen corrigerende maatregelen.
verdict.evidence_span_b: De in lid 6 bedoelde dwangsom wordt dagelijks opgelegd tot aan de verplichtingen is voldaan

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen zien op het omgaan met ICT/AI-gerelateerde risico’s of incidenten, maar leggen niet dezelfde concrete compliancehandeling op.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A vereist dat financiële entiteiten detectiemechanismen inrichten en gebruiken om afwijkende activiteiten, ICT-incidenten en fysieke single points of failure zo spoedig mogelijk te detecteren. Norm B vereist dat aanbieders van GPAI-modellen met systeemrisico relevante informatie over ernstige incidenten en mogelijke corrigerende maatregelen bijhouden, documenteren en onverwijld rapporteren aan het AI-bureau en eventueel nationale autoriteiten. B is dus een informatiebeheer- en meldplicht, terwijl A een voortdurende technische detectiecapaciteit vereist.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste compliance-acties verschillen materieel: technische monitoring/detectie versus documenteren en rapporteren van incidentinformatie.
verdict.evidence_span_a: beschikken over mechanismen om overeenkomstig artikel 17 afwijkende activiteiten zo spoedig mogelijk te detecteren, met inbegrip van kwesties op het gebied van ICT-netwerkprestaties en ICT-gerelateerde incidenten, en om potentiële zwakke fysieke punten (“single points of failure”) te identificeren
verdict.evidence_span_b: relevante informatie over ernstige incidenten en mogelijke corrigerende maatregelen bijhouden, documenteren en onverwijld rapporteren aan het AI-bureau en, in voorkomend geval, aan de nationale bevoegde autoriteiten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the regulated entity to communicate incident information to an external recipient without undue delay or through prescribed incident-reporting procedures.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires notifying the entity’s service recipients (customers/users) about significant incidents that may adversely affect service provision. Norm B requires financial entities to report serious ICT-related incidents, including initial, intermediate, and final reports using prescribed models and within specified regulatory timelines, to the relevant competent authority. The recipients, purpose, content, and reporting process are substantively different.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required recipient and compliance function differ: service-user notification under Norm A versus supervisory/regulatory incident reporting under Norm B.
verdict.evidence_span_a: stelt in voorkomend geval onverwijld de ontvangers van haar diensten in kennis van significante incidenten die een nadelige invloed kunnen hebben op de verlening van die diensten
verdict.evidence_span_b: melden overeenkomstig lid 4 van dit artikel ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incidenten aan de relevante bevoegde autoriteit als bedoeld in artikel 46

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern compliance activities triggered in the context of regulated digital/ICT systems, but they do not require the same practical action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires carrying out a structured programme of technical and security tests of ICT tools and systems, including vulnerability assessments, scans, penetration tests, and other listed tests. Norm B requires notifying the competent authority of a serious incident, with an accelerated deadline where a person has died and a causal link is established or suspected.
verdict.criterion_fired: The operative compliance actions are substantively different: testing/assessment versus incident reporting/notification, even though both relate to digital-system risk events and regulated addressees.
verdict.evidence_span_a: in de uitvoering van passende tests, zoals kwetsbaarheidsbeoordelingen en -scans, opensourceanalyses, netwerkbeveiligingsbeoordelingen, kloofanalyses, beoordelingen van fysieke beveiliging, vragenlijsten en scanningsoftwareoplossingen, beoordelingen van broncodes indien mogelijk, scenariogebaseerde tests, compatibiliteitstests, prestatietests, eind-tot-eindtests en penetratietests

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require reporting an incident to a competent public authority.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the entity to submit a final report (or, under the related paragraph, an interim progress report followed by a final report) to both its CSIRT and competent authority, within specified time limits and with detailed substantive information. Norm B requires reporting the incident itself to the designated national competent authority, with no comparable reporting dossier, CSIRT recipient, or stated deadline in the provision.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance deliverable and procedure differ substantially: a structured, timed final/progress reporting obligation to two recipients versus an incident notification to one designated national authority.

verdict.evidence_span_b: wordt het incident gemeld bij de nationale bevoegde autoriteit die daartoe is aangewezen door de lidstaten waar dat incident zich heeft voorgedaan.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern handling ICT/cyber incidents, but they require different operational actions: Norm A requires a trust-service provider to report a significant incident externally to the CSIRT or competent authority within 24 hours, whereas Norm B requires financial entities to internally register all ICT-related incidents and significant cyber threats and establish processes for monitoring, treatment, follow-up, and root-cause remediation.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is an external incident-notification duty with a specific 24-hour deadline and recipient; Norm B is an internal recordkeeping and incident-management-process duty with no stated deadline or external recipient.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action, recipient, and timing differ in substance: external regulatory reporting versus internal registration and management procedures.
verdict.evidence_span_a: meldt een verlener van vertrouwensdiensten significante incidenten die gevolgen hebben voor de verlening van zijn vertrouwensdiensten onverwijld, en in elk geval binnen 24 uur nadat hij kennis heeft gekregen van het significante incident, bij het CSIRT of, indien van toepassing, de bevoegde autoriteit
verdict.evidence_span_b: Financiële entiteiten registreren alle ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en significante cyberdreigingen. Financiële entiteiten stellen passende procedures en processen vast voor een consistente en geïntegreerde monitoring, behandeling en follow-up van ICT-gerelateerde incidenten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered by a serious or high-impact ICT/data incident and require the regulated entity to take a post-incident compliance measure without delay or as part of incident follow-up.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires communicating the personal-data breach directly to affected data subjects, subject to the stated exceptions. Norm B requires internal post-incident evaluation, root-cause analysis, identification of improvements, and—on request for non-micro-enterprises—communication of implemented changes to competent authorities. These are different recipients and substantive actions.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: external notification to affected individuals versus post-incident assessment and remediation analysis, with possible reporting to authorities.
verdict.evidence_span_a: deelt de verwerkingsverantwoordelijke de betrokkene de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens onverwijld mee
verdict.evidence_span_b: verrichten ICT-gerelateerde post-incidentevaluaties na verstoringen van hun kernactiviteiten ten gevolge van een ernstig ICT-gerelateerd incident, analyseren daarbij de oorzaken van de verstoring en identificeren de verbeteringen die moeten worden aangebracht

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms address cybersecurity-related protection or response, but they do not require the same practical compliance action. Norm A requires an entity to promptly inform potentially affected service recipients about measures they can take in response to a significant cyber threat, and where necessary to notify them of the threat itself. Norm B requires financial entities to deploy suitable ICT technologies and processes that prevent or mitigate specified data-security failures, including loss of availability, compromised authenticity or integrity, confidentiality breaches, and data loss.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is an urgent external communication and guidance duty toward service recipients; Norm B is an ongoing technical and organizational preventive-control duty concerning ICT systems and data protection.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: notification and advice to recipients versus implementation and operation of preventive ICT safeguards.
verdict.evidence_span_a: deelt de ontvangers van haar diensten, die mogelijkerwijs door een significante cyberdreiging in relatie tot het ontvangen van die diensten worden getroffen, onverwijld mee welke maatregelen die ontvangers kunnen nemen in reactie op die dreiging
verdict.evidence_span_b: voorkomen een gebrek aan beschikbaarheid, de aantasting van de authenticiteit en integriteit, de inbreuken op de vertrouwelijkheid en het verlies van gegevens

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational responses to ICT-related risk or incidents, but they do not require the same practical compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the entity to send an early warning about a significant incident to its CSIRT and competent authority, without delay or within 24 hours, including specified information. Norm B requires the financial entity’s governing body to establish and oversee internal governance arrangements and reporting channels for obtaining information about ICT-service-provider arrangements and changes; it is an ongoing governance and oversight duty, not an incident notification.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required acts, recipients, timing, and compliance purpose differ substantially: external incident notification within 24 hours versus establishment and governance of internal ICT-risk and third-party-provider reporting arrangements.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De essentiële entiteit of belangrijke entiteit geeft ten behoeve van de melding, bedoeld in artikel 27, eerste lid, een vroegtijdige waarschuwing over het significante incident aan haar CSIRT en haar bevoegde autoriteit.
verdict.evidence_span_b: het opzetten van meldingskanalen op bedrijfsniveau die het in staat stellen informatie in te winnen over:

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require an entity to provide information connected with a serious/significant ICT incident to a public authority or reporting recipient.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires an early-warning notification containing specific incident-characterisation information (including whether it was likely caused by an unlawful or malicious act), sent without delay or within 24 hours to the CSIRT and competent authority. Norm B requires, only upon request, a separate estimate of aggregated annual costs and losses from serious ICT-related incidents, supplied to competent authorities. The substantive information, procedure, and triggering conditions differ.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required information and compliance procedure are materially different: incident-cause characterisation in an early warning versus an on-request annual financial-loss estimate.
verdict.evidence_span_a: geeft de entiteit aan of het significante incident vermoedelijk door een onrechtmatige of kwaadwillige handeling is veroorzaakt
verdict.evidence_span_b: verstrekken de bevoegde autoriteiten op hun verzoek een raming van de geaggregeerde jaarlijkse kosten en verliezen als gevolg van ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incidenten

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms involve communicating information to another party in connection with an ICT-related event or assessment.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires urgent, proactive communication to potentially affected service recipients about measures they can take in response to a significant cyber threat, and possibly notice of the threat itself. Norm B requires financial entities, other than micro-enterprises, to communicate—only upon request by competent authorities—the changes implemented after post-incident evaluations. The recipients, trigger, content, and proactive/request-based nature differ materially.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: urgent threat-response guidance to potentially affected service recipients versus on-request reporting of post-incident improvements to competent authorities.
verdict.evidence_span_a: deelt de ontvangers van haar diensten, die mogelijkerwijs door een significante cyberdreiging in relatie tot het ontvangen van die diensten worden getroffen, onverwijld mee welke maatregelen die ontvangers kunnen nemen in reactie op die dreiging
verdict.evidence_span_b: delen op verzoek de bevoegde autoriteiten de wijzigingen mee die na de in de eerste alinea bedoelde ICT-gerelateerde post-incidentevaluaties zijn doorgevoerd

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require communication after a significant/serious ICT incident or cyber threat to persons connected with the regulated entity.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the essential or important entity to report every significant incident under the procedures in Articles 26–29, whereas Norm B requires financial entities to notify affected or potentially affected clients directly—without undue delay—about the serious incident and, for the incident case, mitigation measures. The addressee, content, and procedural reporting duty therefore differ substantially.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required action is substantively different: incident reporting under Norm A versus client notification with specified information and urgency under Norm B.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De essentiële entiteit of belangrijke entiteit meldt overeenkomstig de artikelen 26 tot en met 29 ieder significant incident.
verdict.evidence_span_b: stellen financiële entiteiten, zodra zij het incident hebben opgemerkt, hun cliënten onverwijld in kennis van het ernstige ICT-gerelateerde incident en van de maatregelen die zijn genomen om de negatieve gevolgen van een dergelijk incident te beperken.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms impose a mandatory action on regulated entities triggered in the context of digital/cyber compliance: the entity must take a specified administrative/compliance step.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires financial entities to register all ICT-related incidents and significant cyber threats and to establish incident-monitoring, treatment, and follow-up procedures. Norm B requires conformity-assessment bodies to submit an application for notification to the competent notifying authority. These are substantively different actions: ongoing incident recording and process establishment versus filing an application for official notification.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions, objects, and practical outcomes differ in substance, despite both being mandatory administrative obligations for entities in the digital-law domain.
verdict.evidence_span_a: Financiële entiteiten registreren alle ICT-gerelateerde incidenten en significante cyberdreigingen.
verdict.evidence_span_b: Conformiteitsbeoordelingsinstanties dienen een verzoek om aanmelding in bij de aanmeldende autoriteit van de lidstaat waar zij zijn gevestigd.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered by a serious or personal-data ICT incident and require the addressee to take a post-incident compliance step. However, the required steps are not the same: Norm A requires a specified notification to the data-protection authority and affected person, while Norm B requires an internal post-incident evaluation, causal analysis, and identification of improvements.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is an external breach-notification and information-content duty; Norm B is an internal post-incident review and remediation-learning duty, with possible later communication of implemented changes to authorities on request.
verdict.criterion_fired: The norms impose materially different compliance actions in practice: notification of a personal-data breach versus conducting and documenting an ICT post-incident evaluation and identifying improvements.
verdict.evidence_span_a: De kennisgeving aan de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens en de persoon wiens persoonsgegevens het betreft, omvat in ieder geval de aard van de inbreuk in verband met persoonsgegevens, de instanties waar meer informatie over de inbreuk kan worden verkregen en de aanbevolen maatregelen om de negatieve gevolgen van de inbreuk te beperken.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern protecting personal/data security, but they require different operational measures: Norm A requires maintaining a register of all personal-data breaches, including specified facts and information; Norm B requires financial entities to use ICT technologies and processes that prevent or mitigate specified data-security risks.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is a documentation and record-keeping obligation triggered by breaches. Norm B is a preventive technical and organisational security obligation aimed at avoiding availability, authenticity, integrity, confidentiality, and data-loss incidents.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is substantively different: incident-register maintenance versus preventive ICT security controls.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern managing cybersecurity/ICT risks in network or information systems, but they require materially different operational measures.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires an entity, when ordered by the minister, to exclude products or services supplied by designated hostile or connected parties from specified systems. Norm B requires a documented ICT-risk-management framework, continuous monitoring and rapid identification/detection and handling of ICT incidents; it does not impose supplier exclusion.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action is substantively different: targeted supplier prohibition/replacement versus ongoing ICT-risk monitoring, detection, and incident response.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen houden verband met aansprakelijkheid of gevolgen na een ICT-/gegevensverwerkingsincident, maar zij vereisen niet dezelfde concrete compliancehandeling.

Norm B verplicht financiële entiteiten daarentegen tot onverwijlde kennisgeving aan mogelijk getroffen cliënten over een ernstig ICT-incident en genomen beperkende maatregelen; bij significante cyberdreigingen gaat het om informatie over beschermingsmaatregelen.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste handeling verschilt wezenlijk: Norm A betreft het dragen van aansprakelijkheid voor veroorzaakte schade, terwijl Norm B een actieve, tijdgebonden cliëntmelding vereist.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Beide normen betreffen ICT-gerelateerde compliance voor bepaalde entiteiten, maar zij vereisen niet dezelfde concrete handeling.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A vereist externe incidentmelding aan het CSIRT of de bevoegde autoriteit binnen 24 uur na kennisneming van een significant incident. Norm B vereist een interne ICT-risicobeheerhandeling: operationele conclusies uit tests en incidentanalyses opnemen in het ICT-risicobeoordelingsproces.
verdict.criterion_fired: De vereiste handeling, ontvanger en timing verschillen wezenlijk: externe, tijdgebonden incidentrapportage versus interne verwerking van leerpunten in risicobeheer.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both require the responsible service/provider to notify the affected data subject without undue delay of a personal-data breach when the breach meets the applicable harm-risk threshold, subject to specified exceptions.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: The triggering threshold differs: Norm A applies where adverse effects on the person’s privacy are likely, while Norm B applies where a high risk to natural persons’ rights and freedoms is likely. The addressee and practical notification action are otherwise substantially the same; the exceptions also differ in detail.
verdict.criterion_fired: Same operative compliance action: prompt breach notification to the affected individual; the differing risk threshold is a condition for triggering, not a materially different action.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms address action following a digital/ICT risk-related event, but they do not require the same operational compliance action: Norm A requires internal identification and detection of ICT-risk sources and anomalies and rapid handling of ICT incidents, whereas Norm B requires external reporting of each serious incident to the national market-surveillance authority under Article 73.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A is an ongoing internal ICT-risk monitoring and incident-response obligation with an ASAP timing element; Norm B is an incident-triggered notification obligation to a specified public authority, accompanied by immediate mitigation, suspension, or termination duties and a recall procedure.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: internal detection/handling versus external regulatory reporting.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms address ICT-related incidents or risks and involve entities within the digital/financial regulatory sphere, but their operative duties are different.

Norm B requires high-risk AI providers (or, where applicable, deployers) to report serious incidents to market-surveillance authorities, immediately and no later than two days after awareness in the specified circumstances.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational responses to data/ICT security events by regulated entities, but they do not require the same practical action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires a processor to notify the controller promptly after becoming aware of a personal-data breach. Norm B requires financial entities to deploy sufficient resources and capabilities for ongoing monitoring of user activity and ICT anomalies/incidents, including cyberattacks; it does not require notifying another party.

verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A verplicht de entiteit om mogelijk getroffen dienstontvangers te informeren over maatregelen die zij kunnen nemen, en zo nodig ook over de dreiging zelf. verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms are triggered in the context of a significant or operationally relevant ICT event or deployment and concern ICT-related compliance by regulated entities.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires reporting each significant incident to the competent recipient in accordance with the procedures and deadlines in Articles 26–29. Norm B requires conducting vulnerability assessments before deploying or redeploying applications, infrastructure components, or ICT services supporting critical or important functions. Reporting an incident and performing a pre-deployment security assessment are substantively different actions.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms address the handling and reporting of ICT/cyber incidents, but they do not require the same practical compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the entity to submit a specific incident notification to its CSIRT and competent authority, promptly or within 72 hours, including specified incident information. Norm B requires financial entities to establish and implement an ongoing internal ICT-incident management process covering detection, classification, responsibilities, communications, escalation, reporting, and response; it is not itself a specific notification of an incident to the authorities.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required action differs in substance: an event-triggered external incident notification with a deadline versus the creation and operation of a standing internal incident-management process.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern responding to a serious/significant incident, but they do not require the same operational act: Norm A requires an early-warning communication containing specified incident information, while Norm B requires providers to report serious incidents to market-surveillance authorities, followed by investigation and corrective measures.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A's quoted duty is to state whether the significant incident was probably caused by an unlawful or malicious act (as part of an early warning to the CSIRT and competent authority). Norm B requires reporting the serious incident itself to the market-surveillance authorities, with specified timing and subsequent investigation, risk assessment, and corrective action.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action and recipient/procedure differ in substance: incident-characterisation within an early warning versus formal serious-incident reporting to market-surveillance authorities.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern notifying a public authority about a harmful or serious incident involving a regulated digital/data activity.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A specifies the substantive information that the notification must contain and requires notification to both the data-protection authority and affected person; Norm B requires providers or deployers of high-risk AI systems to make an incident report to market-surveillance authorities promptly, within applicable two-, ten-, or fifteen-day limits, but the quoted provision does not impose the same content or affected-person notification duty.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action differs in substance: A is primarily a content-and-recipients requirement for a personal-data breach notification, whereas B is primarily a time-bound reporting obligation for serious high-risk-AI incidents to market-surveillance authorities.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern reporting ICT/cyber incidents by regulated entities to a competent authority or CSIRT.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A imposes a general duty on essential or important entities to report every significant incident under the procedures in Articles 26–29. Norm B imposes an additional reporting destination: specified financial-sector entities must also submit the reports (including a voluntary report) required under the EU Regulation to the designated sectoral CSIRT. Thus, B is an additional/parallel reporting channel for particular financial entities, not the same general incident-reporting duty.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action differs in scope and substance: A requires reporting every significant incident under the NIS2-related procedure, whereas B requires specified financial entities to make certain EU-Regulation reports also to a designated CSIRT.

verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the controller to notify the competent supervisory authority about a personal-data breach, subject to a risk-based exception, with a possible 72-hour deadline and reasons for delay. verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern communicating about ICT/data incidents to external audiences, but they do not require the same operational act.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the controller to promptly notify the affected data subject of a personal-data breach when it is likely to create a high risk, subject to the related exceptions and substitute public communication. Norm B requires the financial entity to designate at least one person to implement its ICT-incident communications strategy and act as spokesperson to the public and media. It is an ongoing governance and spokesperson-designation duty, not a prompt breach notification to affected individuals.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the addressee to submit information or a formal filing to a designated public authority.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational handling of ICT/cyber incidents, but they do not require the same concrete compliance action.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires an affected trust-service provider to make an incident notification to its CSIRT and competent authority, urgently and within 24 hours, when the incident affects the trust service. verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern organizational handling of cybersecurity-related information or events by regulated entities, but they do not require the same practical compliance measure.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires reporting every significant incident to the competent recipient in accordance with the procedures and requirements of Articles 26–29. Norm B requires maintaining capabilities and personnel to collect information about vulnerabilities, cyber threats and ICT incidents and analyze their likely effects on digital operational resilience; it is an internal capacity and analysis obligation, not an incident-reporting duty.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: external notification of significant incidents versus internal resourcing, information gathering, and impact analysis.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms involve providing information to a public authority in response to a security-related event or concern.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires broad, on-request or proactive provision of whatever data and information the Minister needs to prevent or end infringements affecting secure and reliable electronic access. Norm B requires a trust-service provider to report a significant incident affecting its trust services to the CSIRT or competent authority, within 24 hours, as part of a structured incident-reporting process.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ substantively: general information disclosure to a Minister versus time-bound incident notification/reporting to an incident-response body, with the latter involving prescribed warnings, assessments, updates, and reports.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern responding to or managing risks/incidents involving digital or personal-data security, but they do not require the same operational act.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires the content of a notification to the Dutch data-protection authority and affected person after a personal-data breach, including the breach's nature, information sources, and mitigation measures. Norm B requires financial entities to continuously identify ICT-risk sources and assess relevant cyber threats and vulnerabilities, plus periodically evaluate risk scenarios; it is an ongoing risk-management and assessment duty, not an incident-notification duty.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance actions differ in substance: breach notification with specified information versus continuous and periodic ICT-risk identification and assessment.

verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A betreft verantwoordelijkheid voor incidentafhandeling en gevolgen; Norm B betreft het indienen van een aanmeldingsverzoek voor erkenning/aanmelding.

verdict.evidence_span_b: Conformiteitsbeoordelingsinstanties dienen een verzoek om aanmelding in bij de aanmeldende autoriteit van de lidstaat waar zij zijn gevestigd.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms require the organization to create and retain a written account concerning incidents or personal-data breaches, covering the event, its effects, and remedial or mitigating measures, for regulatory oversight.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires a formal final (or, while the incident continues, interim progress) report to be submitted to both the CSIRT and competent authority within a specified timeframe. Norm B requires the controller to document all personal-data breaches so that the supervisory authority can inspect compliance; it does not, in this provision, require submission of a report by a deadline.
verdict.criterion_fired: The obligations differ in their operative compliance action: A is a time-bound external reporting/submission duty, whereas B is an ongoing documentation and record-keeping duty. The overlap in incident information does not make those actions substantially the same.

verdict.shared_compliance_action: Both norms concern communicating or reporting serious ICT/AI-related incidents to external recipients following an incident.
verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A requires financial entities to maintain crisis-communication plans enabling responsible disclosure of serious ICT incidents or vulnerabilities to clients, counterparties, and potentially the public. Norm B requires the incident itself to be reported to the designated national competent authority, for specified high-risk AI systems and a limited category of serious incidents.
verdict.criterion_fired: The required compliance action and recipient differ materially: preparedness and responsible stakeholder/public disclosure under A versus an actual regulatory incident report to a designated authority under B.

verdict.evidence_span_b: wordt het incident gemeld bij de nationale bevoegde autoriteit die daartoe is aangewezen door de lidstaten waar dat incident zich heeft voorgedaan

verdict.distinguishing_factor: Norm A vereist dat het centrale contactpunt periodiek een samenvattend verslag bij Enisa indient met geanonimiseerde en geaggregeerde incident- en dreigingsgegevens.
